learning_outcomes.text: Ability to classify and solve first and higher-order differential equations.
Ability to solve linear differential equations.
Ability to solve systems of linear differential equations.

syllabus_topics: Basic definitions, separable equations and equations reducible to this form
Exact differential equations and integrating factors
Some special types of differential equations
Linear differential equations with constant coefficients
Lagrange method of variation of parameters
Systems of linear ordinary differential equations
assessment_rules: The overall grade is calculated based on a midterm exam weighted at 40% and a final exam weighted at 60%. Midterm and final exam dates are determined by the University Senate and specified in the academic calendar.
